title: CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-06
summary: CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 6, 2026 announcing its Board of Directors approved an additional $500 million share repurchase authorization, bringing the total program to $1.5 billion. The company had already repurchased 413,130 shares at an average price of $364.57 per share for an aggregate of $150.6 million. The program has no fixed expiration date.
key_points: Board approved additional $500 million share repurchase authorization, total now $1.5 billion
Already repurchased 413,130 shares at average price of $364.57 per share
Aggregate purchase price to date: $150.6 million
Repurchases may be made via open market, privately negotiated transactions, Rule 10b5-1 plans
Program does not obligate acquisition of any specific number of shares
Timing and amount of repurchases depend on legal requirements, market conditions, and other factors
